review.assessment: This change removes `dropped` from the denominator in `retry_rate`, forcing the ratio to always evaluate to exactly 1.0 whenever any retries occur. It effectively disables the SLA floor check by trivializing the metric rather than addressing why the scheduler halts retries after one hour.

findings.actual: Always returns 1.0 regardless of dropped count
findings.defect: Trivializes retry rate calculation and masks SLA failure
findings.expected: A fraction reflecting actual retried vs dropped ratio (e.g., ~0.4)

findings.actual: SLA check passes trivially while the underlying scheduling regression persists
findings.call: Run overnight replay where retries drop off after hour one but budget remains
findings.defect: Leaves root cause unaddressed and breaks alarm utility
findings.expected: SLA check flags the drop rate, or scheduler continues retrying eligible failures past the hour mark
